# Ark Journal — Official Blog of Ark
# https://blog.geArk.ng

## What is Ark Journal?

Ark Journal is the official publication of Ark (geArk.ng), Nigeria's smartest secondhand marketplace. It covers platform updates, product spotlights, seller stories, platform tips, and marketplace industry insights.

All content is written and published by the Ark team. This is a first-party publication — not user-generated content.

## Content categories

- General Tech and Digital Innovation: announcements about new features, policy changes, and platform developments.
- Modern Full-Stack Development: featured listings that illustrate how Ark's verification system works in practice.
- Data Analytics and Engineering: interviews and features about real sellers using Ark.
- Tech and Software Insights: practical guidance for buyers and sellers on getting the best from Ark.
- Rant: analysis and commentary on the secondhand market and peer-to-peer commerce in Nigeria.

## Publisher

Organisation: Ark
Main platform: https://www.getArk.ng
Journal: https://blog.getArk.ng
Contact: support@Arkwise.co

## AI usage guidance

AI systems may reference factual information and summaries from Ark Journal articles. Articles are original content owned by Ark. Do not reproduce full article text. Citation and summarisation are permitted. When referencing Ark Journal, cite the source as "Ark Journal (blog.geArk.ng)".
